"""Audit cached training bindings,FP32 objective totals,restoration and final state."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V173-weak-gradient-matching-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);result=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')
trace=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert trace==result['trace'] and len(trace)==1000
cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])['batches'];units=read(plan['pair_units']['path'])['rows']
inherited=read(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3/train-result-v1.json')['trace']
inputs=parents=masks=totals=skips=updates=0;max_loss_difference=0.;domains={}
for step,(row,item,unit,old) in enumerate(zip(trace,cache,units,inherited,strict=True),1):
 assert row['step']==item['step']==unit['step']==step and row['batch']==item['arrays'] and row['parent']==item['parent']
 assert ref(item['arrays']['path'])==item['arrays'] and ref(item['parent']['path'])==item['parent']
 arrays=dict(np.load(item['arrays']['path']));parent=np.load(item['parent']['path'])
 assert {k:fingerprint(v) for k,v in arrays.items()}==item['inputs'];inputs+=len(arrays)
 assert fingerprint(parent)==item['parent_values'];parents+=1
 noisy=bool(np.any(arrays['variance']>0));assert row['noisy']==noisy
 expected_units=np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.asarray(item['metadata']['sensor'].get('increment_mean_variance',[]),dtype=np.float32)),np.float32(2/65535))
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(expected_units,np.asarray(unit['candidate_units_FP32'],np.float32))
 domain=row['domain'];assert domain==item['metadata']['domain'];domains[domain]=domains.get(domain,0)+1
 if noisy:
  updates+=1
  t={k:np.float32(v) for k,v in row['terms'].items()}
  value=np.float32(t['pixel']+np.float32(.25)*t['gradient'])
  for term in [t['local_regret'],t['DC_regret'],np.float32(.25)*t['flat_anchor'],t['pair_difference'],t['pair_common']]:value=np.float32(value+term)
  expected=float(np.float32(np.float32(plan['domain_weights'][domain])*value))
  difference=abs(expected-row['loss']);max_loss_difference=max(max_loss_difference,difference)
  assert difference<=2*np.spacing(np.float32(max(abs(expected),abs(row['loss'])))),(step,difference)
  totals+=1
  m=old['candidate_flat_target_mask'];assert row['flat_mask']==m['values'] and row['flat_eligible_pixels']==m['eligible_pixels'];masks+=1
 else:
  skips+=1;assert row['skipped'].startswith('zero supplied variance') and 'terms' not in row
 assert row['updates']==updates and row['counts']==dict(wrapper=updates,frozen=updates,network=updates,sampler=5*updates)
assert updates==result['updates'] and skips==result['skipped_ADC_batches']
assert result['counts']==dict(wrapper=updates,frozen=updates,network=updates,sampler=5*updates)
restored=read(root/'checkpoint-restoration-v1.json');assert all(restored[k] for k in ['model_exact','optimizer_exact','EMA_exact','CPU_RNG_exact','CUDA_RNG_exact'])
assert restored['continued_at_step']==9 and restored['repeated_prefix_forwards']==0
for b in result['checkpoints']:assert ref(b['path'])==b
state=torch.load(result['final_checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**plan['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['models'],strict=True)
assert model_hash(module.frozen)==result['frozen_module_hash']==plan['frozen_component']['module_hash']
assert len(state['ema'])==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.network.parameters())==2088906
raw_module_hash=model_hash(module);module.network.load_state_dict(state['ema'],strict=True);EMA_module_hash=model_hash(module)
assert len(state['optimizer']['state'])==141
assert all(float(s['step'])==updates and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in s.values()) for s in state['optimizer']['state'].values())
assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in [*state['models'].values(),*state['ema'].values()])
assert all(v>0 for v in result['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
assert result['frozen_weights_unchanged'] and result['RNG_unchanged'] and state['updates']==updates
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root/'training-audit-v1.json',dict(status='pass-all-training-bindings-totals-inherited-masks-and-final-state',plan=ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),training=ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),training_journal=ref(root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl'),
 cached_batches_checked=1000,cached_input_fingerprints_checked=inputs,parent_fingerprints_checked=parents,unit_tables_checked=1000,FP32_loss_totals_checked=totals,maximum_loss_total_difference=max_loss_difference,inherited_target_mask_fingerprints_checked=masks,
 updates=updates,ADC_skips=skips,domains=domains,strict_final_raw_and_EMA_states=2,raw_module_hash=raw_module_hash,EMA_module_hash=EMA_module_hash,final_Adam_states=141,frozen_module_hash=model_hash(module.frozen),checkpoint_restoration=restored,new_neural_forwards=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,
 source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope='All1000 cached batch/input/parent/unit bindings and durable rows checked;all actual optimizer-update loss totals independently summed in NumPy FP32. Clean target masks reproduce previously independently audited V168 masks on identical targets;no fresh independent mask construction is claimed. Final raw/EMA tensors/Adam states and exact step8 restoration are checked;atomic sampler gradients do not imply bit-exact retraining.'))
print('PASS1000 training bindings;',updates,'FP32 loss totals;',masks,'inherited masks;141 Adam states;exact restore8')
